Privacy Policy

This policy explains how Keyra Authenticator (“Keyra”, “we”, “us”) handles information when you use the iOS app and its related backup and account services.

Information Keyra handles

Account and verification. If you create a Keyra account, we process your email address, verification requests and account authentication information to create and protect the account.

Devices and approvals. We process device name, model, platform, operating-system version, device identifiers created for Keyra, public cryptographic keys, push-notification tokens and approval records to manage trusted devices and security notifications.

Verification codes and backup. Your authenticator account details and secrets are stored on your device. When cloud backup is used, the app encrypts the vault on your device before uploading the encrypted backup. The service also stores encrypted key-wrapping material needed for password or recovery-key restoration. Your Backup Password and Recovery Key are not sent to the Keyra service as plain text.

Technical information. Our service may process IP addresses, request timestamps, error information and similar server logs needed to operate, secure and troubleshoot the service. If you contact us, we process the information you send so we can respond.

Photos, camera and biometrics

Keyra uses the camera to scan authenticator QR codes and can read a photo you select to import a QR code. QR detection occurs on your device. If you choose “Save to Photos” for a Recovery Key, the app writes an image containing the full key to your photo library. Your Photos settings, including iCloud Photos, determine whether Apple syncs that image to other devices. Keep it private and delete it from Photos when you no longer need it.

Face ID or device authentication is handled by iOS. Keyra does not receive your biometric data.

Website icons

To display a service’s icon, Keyra may request its favicon directly from that service’s website over HTTPS. The website can see a request from your device, which may reveal that you use that service. Keyra does not include your verification code, authenticator secret or Recovery Key in an icon request. If the icon is unavailable, Keyra shows a text or symbol fallback.

How we use and share information

We use information to verify accounts, provide encrypted backup and recovery, manage trusted devices, send security notifications, prevent misuse and provide support. Hosting, email-delivery and push-notification providers may process the information necessary to deliver those functions. Website operators receive favicon requests as described above. We may disclose information when required by law or necessary to protect the service and its users.

The current Keyra app does not include third-party advertising or analytics SDKs. We do not sell personal information.

Storage, security and retention

Keyra keeps local authenticator data in iOS Keychain and encrypts cloud backups before upload. We retain account and backup information while your account is active and as needed to provide the service. Technical logs and backup copies may remain for a limited period after deletion where needed for security, service operations or legal obligations. No storage or transmission method is completely secure.

Your choices and deletion

You can deny or change camera, Photos, Face ID and notification permissions in iOS Settings. You can delete your Keyra account from the app’s Settings screen; the app requests deletion of the cloud account and clears Keyra data from that device. Removing a code from Keyra does not disable two-factor authentication at the service that issued it. A Recovery Key image already saved to Photos must be deleted separately in Photos, including Recently Deleted if you want it removed promptly.

For access, correction or deletion questions, email keyra@nitratehub.xyz. We may need to verify that you own the account before acting on a request.

International processing and children

Our service providers may process information in countries other than your own. Keyra is not directed to children under 13; if you believe a child has provided personal information, contact us.

Changes and contact

We may update this policy as Keyra changes. The date at the top shows the latest version. For privacy questions, contact keyra@nitratehub.xyz.
